scope: Desktop production-backend/provenance/diagnostic checks only; no native secure VM or in-game reset/taint/render/FPS certification.
scenario: Mapped native Overall/Current/historical/Expired/opaque choices; status instructions; copied results; native ownership through layouts and handoff.
configuration: Lua5.4.6, fresh fixture/process per run; no extra warmup; 500-layout lifecycle bursts; five alternating pairs; no game input/profiler/settings writes.
interpretation: Diagnostics make retained Overall explicit. They do not automatically change the native display or prove per-fight native reset. Original native Current must be selected through its own UI; native acceptance pending.
resources: No new frames/events/hooks/timers. Each on-demand status query reads at most three mapped native configuration records; no actor/text/duration queries.
